units.source_text: 千重子为什么想到要看樟树呢？

en.t: Why had Chieko thought of going to see the camphor trees?

units.source_text: 是因为她曾经在植物园的樟树林荫散过步，

en.t: Was it because she had once walked in the shade of the camphor trees at the botanical garden,

units.source_text: 还是因为她曾讲过北山的杉林是人工培育，

en.t: or because she had said that the cedar woods of Kitayama were cultivated by human hands,

units.source_text: 她喜欢自然成长的大树呢？

en.t: and that she liked great trees that had grown naturally?
